specs.Specific Uses For Product: Home entertainment systems, movie watching, gaming, sports broadcasting, and listening to music
specs.Compatible Devices: Gaming Console, Laptop, Smartphone, Tablet, Television

features: Dual Subwoofers for Punchier Bass: Plunge into a deeply rich audio profile engineered to bring cinema-grade depth straight to your living room. The integration of dual subwoofers delivers a heavy, floor-shaking low-end rumble that makes action sequences and bass lines feel incredibly lifelike. It effectively solves the issue of flat, thin television sound, allowing you to physically feel the impact of your favorite movies.

450W Powerful boAt Signature Sound: Completely dominate your home entertainment space with a massive 450W RMS of thunderous boAt Signature Sound power. This sonic titan projects an extraordinary level of volume and clarity that transforms everyday living rooms into high-fidelity screening arenas. It guarantees that sports broadcasts, blockbuster films, and concert videos are delivered with raw, authentic energy.

5.2 Channel Internal Layout: Experience meticulous audio separation and balance driven by a sophisticated 5.2 channel internal layout. Splitting frequencies across dedicated independent channels, it creates a highly detailed acoustic field where dialogue stays perfectly clean, and sound effect panning is incredibly accurate. It ensures your home entertainment matches the standard of a commercial theater.

Dual Rear Satellites for Surround Sound: Build a true, physical 360-degree acoustic seal around your primary seating area using dedicated dual rear satellite speakers. Placing these sleek units behind your sofa unlocks authentic surround sound, accurately mapping environmental cues and ambient details right behind you.

Versatile Multi-Connectivity Options: Connect your entire media ecosystem seamlessly across multiple input pathways built for modern entertainment devices. Whether you want to utilize advanced Bluetooth v5.4 for drop-free wireless streaming from your phone, or wired paths like HDMI (ARC), Optical, AUX, and USB, it has you covered. It makes shifting between your gaming console, television, and laptop entirely effortless.
